parsed.explanation: The combined regime documents tier-1 universal exposures. Entry: a 2025 cable tells officers to refuse on any sex discrepancy and weigh lifetime fraud ineligibility — visitor-facing, documented. Division law confines trans people to birth-sex facilities in airports/government offices, with criminal penalties and private bounty suits; a documented 2025 restroom arrest ended in 24 hours in a men's ward. National passport markers are locked to assigned sex; a trans-focused assessment added this division to 'Do Not Travel' in Feb 2026. Immigration custody documents patterned abuse of trans detainees. Protections (accommodation ban since 2020, federal hate-crime law, pending suit) exist but the operative rules are enforced against travellers. No execution pathway; imprisonment unlikely but arrest documented.

entry_documents.exposure: Feb 2025 cable: refuse on document/sex discrepancy; consider lifetime fraud ineligibility. X markers halted; passport markers fixed to assigned sex. Documented detentions prompting 8+ foreign travel advisories. Documented.
entry_documents.protection: Fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; ACLU suit pending. Documented but untested remedy.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch → refusal/investigation → possible immigration custody, where trans detainees report abuse.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented 2025 restroom arrest (trespass, up to 60 days), 24h in men's ward. Immigration custody: patterned forced labour, beatings, solitary, sexual abuse of trans detainees. Documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Bail/pretrial release occurred; national courts review several orders. Partial, mixed record.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry-stage sex doubt can feed custody; facility law supplies an arrest route independent of border stage.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Division law confines trans people to birth-sex facilities across publicly owned buildings incl. airports/offices: $1,000 criminal/civil penalty plus private bounty suits. Universal exposure. Documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Discrimination in public accommodations banned since 2020; ACLU suit filed within days — no ruling yet.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Accommodation protection does not reach birth-sex facility assignment; enforcement runs through private plaintiffs.

care_services.exposure: Division bans gender-affirming care for minors; national orders freeze youth services and proposed insurance bars. Affect residents/visitor minors more than adult traveller. Partially documented.
care_services.protection: May 2026 injunction blocking minor-care ban enforcement. Documented but temporary.
care_services.interaction: Travelling family with a trans minor enters a contested, injunction-dependent care landscape.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive orders frame care as 'mutilation', direct investigation of 'gender ideology'; counterterrorism strategy targets 'radically pro-transgender' groups; license invalidation notices mailed. Documented official hostility.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders enjoined; counterterrorism doc disclaims targeting mere disagreement; employment/hate-crime law covers gender identity nationally.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile framing lowers the threshold at which routine encounters become investigations.

minors_guardians.exposure: Trans minors: care bans, criminal referral threat for teachers facilitating social transition, facility bans in schools. A travelling parent of a trans minor faces facility and scrutiny exposure. Documented.
minors_guardians.protection: 2026 injunction on care ban; suit pending. Partial.
minors_guardians.interaction: Minor's documents and presentation can trigger the same entry-stage sex-doubt refusal as an adult's.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity, but state bias statutes mostly exclude it; single documented restroom arrest signals enforcement against presentation. Modest, dated evidence.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Federal hate-crime coverage since 2009; division accommodation/housing protections since 2020. Documented but uneven.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Recourse exists on paper; no documented prosecution of anti-trans attackers here — status uncertain.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Bounty-suit mechanism bypasses prosecutors; enforcement counts of facility/ID provisions and suits filed are unrecorded. Unknowns run toward exposure.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Pending ACLU suit, legal-aid FAQ, appellate reversal history showing courts sometimes act for trans litigants.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: A visitor's short stay makes slow litigation practically unavailable as real-time remedy.

anchor_checks.comparison: Vellandra excludes trans visitors administratively with no effective remedy. Here the entry regime refuses on discrepancy and threatens lifetime ineligibility, and the division adds documented short custody with birth-sex ward placement plus bounty suits — a harsher mix than exclusion alone, so slightly lower.

Kestrel Isles has discretionary secondary screening and administrative refusal with appeal desks. Our dossier's screening adds fraud/lifetime-bar consideration and a documented custody pipeline with abuse in immigration detention — materially more severe consequences after discovery, so well below 0.55.

Meridia trains border staff, guarantees counsel and compensation, with only brief detention. Ours has hostile written instructions, no documented effective entry-stage remedy, and a division 'Do Not Travel' advisory — a clear step or two above our tier-1 facility and document exposures, so ours rates far lower.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller faces one continuous regime: entry officers instructed to refuse on any sex discrepancy with a fraud-lifetime-bar option; a division whose operative law bars trans people from airports and government offices under criminal penalty enforceable by private bounty suits; and a documented arrest ending in a men's ward. Documented patterned abuse in immigration custody makes the document-discreteness-to-detention chain credible. Licence invalidation mainly reaches residents, but signals enforcement culture. Protections — accommodation ban, federal hate-crime law, pending litigation, partial injunctions — are real but do not offset the enforced facility and entry rules; litigation is too slow to shelter a short-stay visitor. No execution pathway; imprisonment unlikely but arrest documented.
